@@name@@Chum the Waters@@icon@@Chum the Waters.png@@icon2@@{{{icon2}}}@@description@@'''Active:''' '''Fizz''' throws down a lure at the target location that attracts a shark, granting [[File:Sight icon.png|20px|link=Sight|An icon representing the keyword Sight]] [[:Sight|sight]] of the area before it emerges to chomp at the lure after 2 seconds, dealing magic damage to nearby enemies, [[File:Airborne icon.png|20px|link=Airborne|An icon representing the keyword Airborne]] [[:Airborne|knocking them back]], though not through terrain, and [[File:Slow icon.png|20px|link=Slow|An icon representing the keyword Slow]] [[:Slow|slowing]] them for 2 seconds. The further the lure travels in its initial flight, the larger the shark that is attracted; increasing ''Chum the Waters' '' damage, slow, eruption radius and knock back distance.@@description2@@'''Guppy (<455):''' 40% slow, 200 eruption radius and 150 unit knock back distance.@@description3@@'''Chomper (455-910):''' 125% damage, 60% slow, 325 eruption radius and 250 unit knock back distance.@@description4@@'''Gigalodon (>910):''' 150% damage, 80% slow, 450 eruption radius and 350 unit knock back distance.@@description5@@Enemy [[File:Champion icon.png|20px|link=Champion|An icon representing the keyword Champion]] [[:Champion|champions]] can intercept the lure while it is in flight, which attaches to them upon contact and causes the shark to emerge at their position after the same delay. The lure's holder is [[File:Slow icon.png|20px|link=Slow|An icon representing the keyword Slow]] [[:Slow|slowed]] and [[File:True Sight icon.png|20px|link=Sight#True_sight|An icon representing the keyword True sight]] [[:Sight#True_sight|revealed]] for the duration and afterwards is impacted by the eruption but is [[File:Airborne icon.png|20px|link=Airborne|An icon representing the keyword Airborne]] [[:Airborne|knocked up]] for 1 second instead of knocked back.@@description6@@{{{description6}}}@@leveling@@{{{leveling}}}@@leveling2@@

Collision with [[File:Mel OriginalSquare.png|20xpx|border|link=Mel|An icon representing Mel]] [[Mel|Mel's]] [[File:Mel Rebuttal.png|20xpx|border|link=Mel#Rebuttal|An icon for Mel's ability Rebuttal]] [[Mel#Rebuttal|Rebuttal]] will destroy it altogether, however. * This ability will cast from wherever the caster is at the end of the cast time. ** The targeted area does not change unless the ability was cast beyond maximum range. * If the lure attaches to an enemy champion, a countdown will appear at their position to signify when the shark is about to emerge.
